articles.label: Tesla
articles.headline: Tesla Shares Climb Nearly 3% to $336 as Robotaxi Gains and AI Push Offset Profit Pressure
articles.summary: Tesla shares rose nearly 3% after reporting record vehicle deliveries and advancements in AI and autonomy, despite facing profitability challenges and increased capital expenditures.
